title: Platereader Workflow with V. natriegens
author: Daniel Stukenberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uy9exz6

steps.title: Prepare Inoculation Tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of LBv2 into 1.5 mL reaction tubes and transfer material from the glycerol stock into these tubes.

steps.title: Inoculate 96-well Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a transparent 96-well plate containing 190 µL of LBv2 per well and inoculate with 10 µL of LBv2 containing cells from the glycerol stock.

substeps.instruction: Perform the experiment with four technical replicates.

steps.title: Perform Preculture Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the 96-well plate in a platereader using the Preculture protocol.

substeps.instruction: Set for 37 cycles with a 600 s cycle time.
Set shaking to Double orbital at 500 rpm.
Configure OD600 (Absorbance) measurement: Wavelength 600 nm, Settling Time 0.5 s, and 30 flashes.

steps.title: Perform First Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the grown cultures 1:40 in a sterile 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Combine 195 µL LBv2 and 5 µL of culture.

steps.title: Measure OD600 of First Dilution
steps.instruction: Measure the OD600 of the diluted cultures using the Shaking (Absorbance) protocol.

substeps.instruction: Set shaking to Double Orbital, 300 s, at 700 rpm.

steps.title: Perform Second Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the grown cultures 1:50 in a black sterile 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Combine 196 µL LBv2 and 4 µL of culture.

steps.title: Run Measurement Protocol
steps.instruction: Start the measurement protocol (OD+Lux, OD+GFP, or OD+RFP) in the plate reader.

substeps.instruction: For OD + Lux: Set for 121 cycles with a 300 s cycle time.
Set shaking to Double orbital at 500 rpm.
Configure OD600 (Absorbance): Wavelength 600 nm, Settling Time 0.5 s, and 30 flashes.
Configure Luminescence: Gain 4000 and Measurement interval time 1 s.
